_README: Per-query accuracy + freshness SLAs for the Fig-12 controller-allocation harness.
IMPORTANT: the SLA is an EXPLICIT INPUT to the controller/oracle. PromQL alone does
NOT fix the accuracy target -- `histogram_quantile(0.99, ...)` says WHAT to compute,
not how tight the answer must be. The accuracy budget comes from (a) a per-query
annotation (this file), (b) a per-kind class default, or (c) the sketch family's
native epsilon. Here we annotate per kind, anchored to the in-tree e2e thresholds
in `compare.py` (THRESHOLDS) so the harness SLAs match what the e2e PASS/FAIL gate
quantile     -> max relative error on the returned quantile value (rel-err <= x)
count_unique -> max relative error on the distinct count (rel-err <= x)
sum          -> max relative error on the sum (sketch Sum is exact-ish; tiny x)
topk         -> MIN recall@k (fraction of true top-k present); >= x
frequency    -> max relative error on the point frequency estimate (rel-err <= x)
freshness_slo_s: max open-window staleness in seconds the query tolerates. The
continuous-monitoring sub-window emit cadence must keep open-window error <= eps_cdm;
we map freshness_slo_s -> an eps_cdm budget via eps_cdm ~= staleness/window (the
fraction of a 30s window that can be un-emitted). See controller_alloc_eval.py.
